topic: Picking Up a Custom Birthday Cake

script.title: THE CAKE PICKUP
script.title_quote: Wait, MARC? His name is MARCO.
script.story_hook: One missing letter ruins a cake pickup.
script.intro_zh: 少了一個字母，取蛋糕有了小插曲。
script.welcome_en: Hello, and welcome to the bakery! Today, a sweet weekend mission.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎來到蛋糕坊！今天是一趟甜甜的週末任務。
script.outro: Fixed, boxed, and flat. Small mistakes make great stories.
script.outro_zh: 修好了、裝好了、端平了。小錯誤也能變成好故事。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the bakery lines together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起跟讀蛋糕坊的句子。
script.char_a_description: A tired but smiling man in his forties with close-cropped graying hair, reading glasses, an olive flannel shirt, dark jeans, and a worn canvas backpack over one shoulder.
script.char_b_description: A stout woman in her fifties with rosy cheeks, silver hair in a flour-dusted bun, a cream apron over a burgundy sweater, and a pair of oven mitts at her side.
script.thumbnail_expression: peeking worriedly at a cake box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here for my cake pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪm hɪɹ fɔɹ maɪ keɪk ˈpɪkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我來取訂的蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good afternoon! Do you have the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈæftɚˌnuːn! du ju hæv ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 午安！請問有收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, order number forty-two, from last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɔːrdɚ ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɔːrti tuː, fɹəm læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 有，上週訂的四十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, today is Friday, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm, təˈdeɪ ɪz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ, ɪz ðæt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，今天是星期五，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, we booked for three o'clock today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi bʊkt fɔɹ θɹi əˈklɑk təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，約的是今天三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the board… yes, here it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə bɔːɹd… jɛs, hɪɹ ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我看一下紀錄板……有了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it under the name Marco?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə neɪm ˈmɑːɹkoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 登記的名字是 Marco 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco, order forty-two? That's the one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑːɹkoʊ, ˈɔːrdɚ ˈfɔːrti tuː? ðæts ðə wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 四十二號的 Marco？就是這盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, my family still argues about that name.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, maɪ ˈfæməli stɪl ˈɑːɡjuːz əˈbaʊt ðæt neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我們家還在為那個名字拌嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens! The cake is almost finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz! ðə keɪk ɪz ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈfɪnɪʃt/
dialogue.zh: 常常這樣啦！蛋糕快完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost? I thought it was ready this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔːlmoʊst? aɪ θɔt ɪt wəz ˈɹɛdi ðɪs ˈmɔːɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 快了？我以為今天早上就做好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The icing needed more time to set firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈaɪsɪŋ ˈnidɪd mɔːɹ taɪm tə sɛt fɜːɹm/
dialogue.zh: 糖霜需要多一點時間定型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem, we can wait twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm, wi kæn weɪt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，等二十分鐘也還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for understanding, truly. One moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju fɔɹ ˌʌndɚˈstændɪŋ, ˈtɹuːli. wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 真的很感謝您的體諒。稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Um, can I peek at the design?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ. ʌm, kaɪ pik ət ðə dɪˈzaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃，可以先看一眼造型嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here's the rocket ship cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔːɹs, hɪɹz ðə ˈɹɑkɪt ʃɪp keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這就是火箭蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that looks exactly like the photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðæt lʊks ɪɡˈzæktli ˈlaɪk ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，跟照片一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The frosting stars are piped by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɹɔstɪŋ stɑːɹz ɑɹ paɪpt baɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 那些星星糖霜都是手工擠出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this blue is his favorite color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs bluː ɪz hɪz ˈfeɪvɚɪt ˈkʌlər/
dialogue.zh: 這個藍色也是他最喜歡的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But there's something you should check first.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðɛɹz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ju ʃʊd tʃɛk fɜːst/
dialogue.zh: 但有個地方，您最好先看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check? What should I look for?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk? wʌt ʃʊd aɪ lʊk fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看什麼？要看哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, look at the name on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, lʊk ət ðə neɪm ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 就是最上面寫的那個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, MARC? His name is MARCO.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ˈmɑːɹk? hɪz neɪm ɪz ˈmɑːɹkoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，MARC？他叫 MARCO。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry, the piping bag slipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi, ðə ˈpaɪɪŋ bæɡ slɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 真抱歉，擠字袋滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it be fixed, or should I worry?
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪt bi fɪkst, ɔɹ ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɜːɹi/
dialogue.zh: 還能修好嗎？我該擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easily, five minutes with a fresh bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizəli, faɪv ˈmɪnɪts wɪð ə fɹæʃ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 很容易，換個新袋只要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like magic, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk ˈmædʒɪk, teɪk jɔːɹ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很神奇，您慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, an O in exactly the same blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ, ən oʊ ɪn ɪɡˈzæktli ðə seɪm bluː/
dialogue.zh: 好了，這個 O 的藍色一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't even see the fix. Nice!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt ˈivɚ si ðə fɪks. naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 完全看不出修補的痕跡。太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buttercream hides everything, that's the trade secret.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtɚˌkɹim haɪdz ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ, ðæts ðə tɹeɪd ˈsikɹɪt/
dialogue.zh: 奶油霜能藏住一切，這是業界秘密。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, um, did you pack the candles?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːɹfɪkt. naʊ, ʌm, dɪd ju pækt ðə ˈkændəlz/
dialogue.zh: 完美。呃，蠟燭有幫我們裝好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're in the little silver box, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪn ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈsɪlvɚ bɑks, ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就在這個小銀盒裡，給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, last year we forgot those completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt, læst jɪɹ wi fɚˈɡɑt ðoʊz kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，去年我們整個忘記帶蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight candles, one for each year, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈkændəlz, wʌn fɔɹ itʃ jɪɹ, ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 八根蠟燭，一年一根，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he turns eight this Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hi tɜːnz eɪt ðɪs ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，他這週日就滿八歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How big is the party this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪɡ ɪz ðə ˈpɑːɹti ðɪs jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 今年的派對規模多大？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve kids, pizza first, then the cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv kɪdz, ˈpitˌsɑː fɜːst, ðɛn ðə keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 十二個小孩，先吃披薩，再吃蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This size feeds sixteen, so no worries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs saɪz ˈfidz sɪksˈtin, soʊ noʊ ˈwɜːɹiz/
dialogue.zh: 這個尺寸夠十六個人吃，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief, the whole family is coming too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlif, ðə hoʊl ˈfæməli ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ tuː/
dialogue.zh: 放心了，我們全家也會一起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need a cake knife today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ə keɪk naɪf təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天需要蛋糕刀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have a plastic one, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ə ˈplæstɪk wʌn, aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想我們有一把塑膠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better trick: run a warm knife first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ trɪk: ɹʌn ə wɔɹm naɪf fɜːst/
dialogue.zh: 更好的訣竅：先用熱刀過一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, my wife will thank you for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp, maɪ waɪf wɪl θæŋk ju fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好招，我太太會感謝你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep it chilled until five minutes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip ɪt tʃɪld əmˈtɪl faɪv ˈmɪnɪts aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 還有，要享用的前五分鐘再從冰箱拿出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fridge, then counter, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹɪdʒ, ðɛn ˈkaʊntɚ, ɡɑt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先放冰箱，再放桌上，記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Will the ride home be cool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli. wɪl ðə ɹaɪd hoʊm bi kul/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。回家的車上有冷氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The AC is broken, my car is an oven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌeɪ ˈsi ɪz ˈbɹoʊkən, maɪ kɑɹ ɪz ˈʌvən/
dialogue.zh: 冷氣壞了，車裡像烤爐一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no — take this insulated bag, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ — teɪk ðɪs ˈɪnsəˌleɪtɪd bæɡ, pliz/
dialogue.zh: 噢不——請把這個保冷袋帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you sure? I'll pay for the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑɹ ju ʃʊɹ? aɪl peɪ fɔɹ ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好意思嗎？袋子的錢我來付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just bring it back Monday, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst brɪŋ ɪt bæk ˈmʌnˌdeɪ, ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 週一送回來就好，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're solving every problem today, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈsɑlvɪŋ ˈɛvɹi ˈpɹɑbləm təˈdeɪ, ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，您今天把我的問題全解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Birthday cakes are serious business around here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɜːɹθˌdeɪ keɪks ɑːɹ ˈsɪɹiəs ˈbɪznəs əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，生日蛋糕可是大事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! My son would agree completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! maɪ sʌn wʊd əˈɡɹi kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我兒子一定完全同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the box — carry it flat, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə bɑks — ˈkæɹi ɪt flæt, ˈɔlˌweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 盒子給您——記得永遠平著端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat, no tilting, like a sleeping baby.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt, noʊ ˈtɪltɪŋ, laɪk ə ˈslipɪŋ ˈbeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 平平的、不斜，像抱著熟睡的寶寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly right, you're a natural.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɹaɪt, jʊɹ ə ˈnætʃɚəl/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，您很有天分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the fix and the free lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ðə fɪks ænd ðə ˈfɹi ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您幫忙修正，還上了免費一課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy birthday to Marco from all of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi ˈbɜːɹθˌdeɪ tə ˈmɑːɹkoʊ fɹəm ɔl əv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 我們全體祝 Marco 生日快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll tell him, he'll love the rocket ship.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛl hɪm, hil lʌv ðə ˈɹɑkɪt ʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我會轉達，他一定愛死這艘火箭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a wonderful party, and see you soon!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈpɑːɹti, ænd ˈsi ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 祝派對順利，蛋糕坊歡迎您再來！

script.youtube_description:
興高采烈去取生日蛋糕，湊近一看才發現名字少了一個字母，該怎麼救？這集60句沉浸式英文聽力，帶你走完一次蛋糕坊取貨全流程。

劇情：爸爸週五下午來取為兒子訂製的火箭蛋糕，蠟燭盒、尺寸人數、保冷袋一樣樣確認，才發現頂上的名字寫成了少一個字的 MARC。麵包師傅換了新擠花袋，五分鐘補好字，還傳授熱刀切蛋糕與平端盒子的小撇步。

你將學會：
- 用 I'm here for my cake pickup 開始取貨對話
- 用 Can it be fixed? 溫和提出問題
- 聊保冷、搬動與派對細節的常用句

每句都附國際音標與繁中翻譯，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能開口用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
記得訂閱頻道、開啟小鈴鐺，每天一集沉浸式英文！
script.youtube_description_en:
You pick up the custom birthday cake, and the name on top has a missing letter - now what? In this 60-line immersive English listening lesson, a dad and a friendly baker fix the icing, count the candles, and solve a hot-car problem with an insulated bag.

You will learn to:
- Start the pickup with I'm here for my cake pickup
- Ask Can it be fixed? without making a scene
- Talk about sizes, candles, timing, and carrying the box flat

Every line stays under ten words, with IPA and translations, plus a line-by-line repeat section.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new immersive listening quest every week!

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
期待已久的火箭蛋糕就在眼前，名字卻少了最後一個字母，你會怎麼開口？
這一集帶大家走進蛋糕坊的取貨櫃台，看一位爸爸和經驗老道的麵包師傅一起把錯誤五分鐘抹平，還學到一整套帶蛋糕回家的本事。
你會聽到：
- 🎂 「Wait, MARC? His name is MARCO.」— 溫和指出訂單錯誤。
- 🖌️ 「Can it be fixed, or should I worry?」— 詢問能不能補救。
- 🧊 「Take this insulated bag, please.」— 車子沒冷氣時的救星。
- 🔪 「Carry it flat, always.」— 端蛋糕的黃金準則。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧，每句十詞以內，慢速清楚，讓你聽了就想跟著唸。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
祝每一次慶生，都平平安安、甜甜蜜蜜！
